market_context: The Nasdaq-100 fell 0.71% to 30,664.70 (QQQ −0.70% to $746.04) as memory and AI-infrastructure shares sold off after China's CXMT flagged denser DRAM progress and a year-end server-memory plan, while Meta jumped on its Muse Wonder frontier-model launch; the Dow rose 0.38% and the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.44%.
market_cap_basis: Shares outstanding x 2026-10-12 close. Shares implied from Nasdaq market caps as of the 2026-10-05 close (watchlist market_cap_usd / 2026-10-05 close), so multi-class companies (e.g. GOOGL) reflect all share classes.

stocks.reason: Dropped with the memory complex after China's ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) said it made "key progress" on a denser 4F² DRAM cell design and plans a server-memory product by year-end—even though SanDisk sells NAND flash, not DRAM—as sector sentiment dragged flash and storage names lower (Roundhill Memory ETF DRAM ~−4%).
